seed_fact: A blog with 5 starter posts adds 1 week. Don't launch a blog with zero content.
caption:
Thinking your new site can go live tomorrow? Not if your blog is empty. Adding just five starter posts adds about a week to the build—quality content needs time to design and rank. DM me to plan a launch schedule that works for your business.
